note: Independent rejudge against RFC 2869 Section 5.2 ("This attribute indicates how many times the Acct-Output-Octets counter has wrapped around 2^32 in the course of delivering this service, and can only be present in Accounting-Request records where the Acct-Status-Type is set to Stop or Interim-Update."). In 38267f5e0c, both tagged units migrated from the interface-name stub to the original-PPP-unit capture fixture (bindAcctUnit). TestRFC2869OutputGigawordsOnInterimUpdate binds a live capture with 3*2^32+200 tx over zero baseline and asserts exact Acct-Output-Octets 200 and Acct-Output-Gigawords 3 on an Interim-Update built by buildAcctPacket/splitGigawords. TestRFC2869OutputGigawordsAbsentOnStart binds the same wrapped live capture and asserts Acct-Output-Gigawords is absent on Start; verified in acct.go that recordCounters takes liveDelta on non-Stop so removing the Stop/Interim guard in buildAcctPacket would fail the negative. Verdict enforced stands.
